name: Blazing Fury Demo
author: RTArt
description:
Made in one month. All graphics and animations done by myself ! 

Controls : 
Main Menu : W/S/Up/Down (move cursor) - Enter (select option)
In Game : WASD (move) - double input (Dash) / K (Attack) / L (Jump) / Esc (Pause Menu)

For those who can't play the game here, you can download the demo (PC) at https://yodaxy.itch.io/blazing-fury

Thanks for the feedback !
